description: SID_SKIP_BOTS=likely, with the bot module (missingHeaders on, internalCookie its_me) supplying the verdict: a browser user agent with an empty Accept-Language is a likely bot. A qualifying request gets no ID cookie and no SharedID, with X-SharedID-Status: skipped: bot, and an existing ID is neither deleted nor refreshed. Internal traffic isn't skipped. Consent denial still takes precedence and deletes the ID. On /sync (Prebid.js's pixelUrl) the bot module runs too, and its report joins the platform's verdict (not available on every target; see the unit tests): a likely bot gets no ID there either, and the response isn't cached.
